answer: Challenge chain: each epoch the beacon posts one challenge; an identity answers it to forge the next link. Each link costs 40 credits, bears a basalt seal binding one key, and must echo the prior link's hash, so no copied link fits a second chain. A mirror ledger publishes each link; a shared link burns both chains. Five links make one identity: 1,000 fakes pay 200,000; an honest agent pays 200 once and keeps its chain. Rented links fail replay.
